review_notes: I read the whole file. It declares only two definitions, `bitCount` and `estimate`, plus the theorem `success` and the lemma `bitCount_eq`. `bitCount` is a product of the repetition count and the per-run bit count. `estimate` is a project-specific wrapper: it applies `rationalMedian` to the flat estimates of the repetition words, which `gridWordEquiv` splits out of the bit string. Neither is a competing version of a Mathlib concept. The median, `uniformAverage` and the word equivalence all come from imported project files and are not defined here. The theorem and lemma are not definitions, and the rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication. I did not look into the imported project files, so I cannot rule out a duplicate there, but that would not be a defect in this file.
